reason: Twenty-two thousand is about a month and more of what our whole house earns, and nobody I know has used a washing machine that runs on a battery. I won't put that money down until someone in the family or the neighbour has had one working for a season.
objection: Who will repair it in my village when it stops, and when the battery dies after three years, how much will a new one cost? If the battery is half the price of the machine, it is a trap.
would_change_my_mind: A relative or neighbour using one for a few months without trouble, and the dealer telling me in writing what a replacement battery costs.
